# Bid the opening, the leaf, and the extras.

> Price an interior door replacement from door count, hollow slab versus solid-core versus French-or-barn, hang-only versus pocket-conversion, owner-supplied versus carpenter-supplied, weekday versus Saturday overtime, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $150-a-door special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
